name: Rothschild College

decisions: Metro has 2 footprints here where OSM has one; compared against their union, OSM kept as one building (roof parts split it)
OSM and Metro differ (corner p95 16.00 m); OSM is as close or closer to the LiDAR edge (1.00 vs 1.32 m): OSM used

material_rule: walls and vertical roof steps brick_red (guess); roof faces flatter than 6 deg roof_flat, steeper roof_slate unless the Metro 2026 ortho color is clearly green (roof_copper) or orange-red (roof_tile); base concrete

collider.kind: one non-convex static triangle mesh (LoD2 shell without base cap)

accuracy.reason: P2 (curved, 212 m2): eave -0.21 m, ridge +0.16 m, 99% of roof points within 0.5 m; P3 (curved, 95 m2): eave +0.71 m, ridge +0.01 m, 96% of roof points within 0.5 m

footprint.reference: osm outline; LiDAR edge for moved corners
